(a2, a3, b2, b3) Li-ion migration pathways of n-Li2SiS3 (a2, a3) and e-Li2SiS3 (b2, b3). (a4, b4) Energy proﬁles of the migration pathways in n-Li2SiS3 (a4) and e-Li2SiS3 (b4).
